name: Euphoria | 28g Prepackaged Flower | Super Star Fruit
description:
Balance
-Top terpenes – Myrcene, Limonene, Caryophyllene
 -Hybrid strain and a cross between Starfire Chem x Early Orange
-Star Fruit is a strain that harvests chunky bright buds with evenly dispersed burnt orange pistils. 
-Emits an aroma with overtones of sweet tropical fruits with hints of damp earth & pepper.
-Effects may start with a sense of euphoria as negative thoughts are stripped away.
-Many say they enjoy this strain to help enhance creative endeavors.

The cultivars selected for our Euphoria line were chosen for their superior terpene profiles, high testing THC percentages and unique experiences. Euphoria Ultra-Premium Pre-Rolls are made with Full Flower, Never any shake/trim or remediation. Euphoria Brand Pre-Rolls comes in Strain Specific, Unique, Pop Culture packaging designed to appeal to all Cannasseurs.
